worksheet.title: Iteration Decision Worksheet
worksheet.description: Diagnose what is not working, plan your next iteration, and record what you learned.

fields.label: Diagnosis
fields.helpText: Where in the chain is the problem? Be honest — this shapes what to fix.
options: Good traffic, low conversion — listing or offer problem
Good traffic + conversion, CPA too high — ad efficiency problem
Good traffic + conversion, margin too thin — cost structure problem

fields.label: Evidence for this diagnosis
fields.helpText: What specific numbers or observations led you to this diagnosis?

fields.label: Planned iteration
fields.helpText: One specific change you will make this cycle. Be precise. (e.g. 'Rewrite the description opening paragraph to lead with the problem')

fields.label: Expected outcome
fields.helpText: What metric do you expect to improve, and by roughly how much?

fields.label: Iteration result
fields.helpText: Fill this in after the iteration cycle. What actually happened? Did the metric move?

fields.label: Decision
fields.helpText: Based on the result, what is your next move?
options: Pivot product — same customer, different product
Pivot customer — same product, different audience
Pivot channel — same product + customer, different traffic source
Pivot offer — same product, different packaging or price
